parts.text: (b) (i) Beatrice invests $500 at a rate of 1.5% per year simple interest. Find the amount Beatrice has at the end of 12 years. $ ................................................ [3]

content.tex: Beatrice invests \(\$500\) at a rate of \(1.5\%\) per year simple interest.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Dan invests $500 at a rate of 1.5% per year compound interest. Find the difference between Dan’s amount and Beatrice’s amount at the end of 12 years. $ ................................................ [3]

content.tex: Dan invests \(\$500\) at a rate of \(1.5\%\) per year compound interest.

content.tex: Eva invests an amount of money at a rate of \(2.1\%\) per year compound interest.

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Each year the value of Fred’s car reduces by 15% of its value at the start of that year. The value of the car is now $5158.65 . Find the value of Fred’s car 3 years ago. $ ................................................ [3]

content.tex: Each year the value of Fred’s car reduces by \(15\%\) of its value at the start of that year. The value of the car is now \(\$5158.65\) .
